final_text:
Done. The testimonials section is built and verified.

**What was added** — a `<section id="testimonials">` inserted directly below the hero, styled with BaroCSS utility classes only (matching the page's existing conventions: `max-w-7xl mx-auto`, `border-t border-slate-200`, `py-16 sm:py-20`). It contains:

- A centered header ("Loved by product teams" with a badge + subtitle).
- Three quote cards in a responsive grid: `grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6` — **one column on small screens, three on wide**.
- Each card (`<figure>`) has a quote icon, the **quote** in a `<blockquote>`, and a `<figcaption>` with a **round avatar placeholder** (initials on a gradient circle, `w-12 h-12 rounded-full`), the person's **name**, and their **role**.

**Verification:**
- At **1280px**: all three cards share the same top (457px) at increasing left offsets (32 / 445 / 859) → single row of three columns. ✅
- At **390px**: cards stack vertically (tops 587 / 887 / 1187, all at left 16) → single column. ✅
- Avatar computed style: 48×48px with `border-radius: 9999px` → round. ✅
- Console: 0 errors.

**One fix applied during build:** the BaroCSS resolution report flagged `leading-relaxed` as UNDEFINED-VAR (the page never defines `--line-height-relaxed`), so it would have had no effect. I swapped it for the arbitrary value `leading-[1.7]`, which resolves correctly. Every other class resolved cleanly.
